item.content:encoded:
I have just a couple issues with this, which are purely word choice.

SCP-680-2 has no particular effect when removed from the SCP-680-1 and tested with D-Class (or other) personnel
As such, however, much of its empirical data is either frustratingly vague or presented in a riddle.

Both of these feel very awkward, why 'with D-class (or other)' and not just 'human subjects'? As such, however, there are unnecessary words in this.

Also, was the possible connection to Nazis intentional?
